definitions.explanation: Something that already exists or is already in place, as opposed to something newly created. Almost always used attributively as {既存|きそん}の.

examples.japanese: {既存|きそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{既存|きそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧。
examples.english: The new proposal is better than the existing one.

examples.japanese: {既存|きそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}さ→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: We will renovate and use the existing building rather than demolishing it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{既|き}→既〜：28657_ki⟧ (already) + {存|そん} (to exist). Refers to what already exists, in contrast to something new. Read きそん, though きぞん is sometimes heard colloquially.

USAGE:
Almost always used attributively, with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before a noun:
- {既存|きそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧: the existing system
- {既存|きそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: an existing building
- {既存|きそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧: existing customers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{現行|げんこう}→現行：13503_genkou⟧: current; in force — used for rules and systems currently in effect
- ⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧: conventional; up to now — emphasizes 'as it has been until now'
